name: The Pet Fund
description: One-time grants for non-basic, non-urgent veterinary care (usually has a waitlist)
fullDescription: The Pet Fund is a national nonprofit that provides one-time grants for non-basic, non-urgent veterinary care to U.S. pet owners who cannot afford treatment.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-time grants for non-basic, non-urgent care (cancer treatment, heart disease, chronic conditions, endocrine and eye diseases)
- Does NOT cover basic care (spay/neuter, dental, vaccines), urgent care, or emergencies
- Usually has a waitlist, so care must be able to wait
- For already-adopted animals of U.S. residents
howToGetIt:
1. Email The Pet Fund first with a description of your pet's medical needs and your phone number
2. Wait for staff to review; do not send an application until they tell you to
3. If invited, complete The Pet Fund application
4. Expect a waitlist before funding
keywords: The Pet Fund, vet financial assistance, pet treatment, diabetes, cancer, heart disease, chronic care, non-emergency, afford vet
